collection_responsibility.artifact_name_uniqueness: Normal cleanup requires each of eight evidence artifacts exactly once, optional diagnostics at most once, and run-record separately. Abnormal evidence-only does not require a complete bundle; missing_artifacts is exact absent required names, unavailable_artifacts is present but unsafe/unreadable/over-cap required names, and the sets are disjoint.
collection_responsibility.failure_summary_binding: The finalizer recomputes code, phase, last_event_sequence, inventory_availability, cleanup_outcome and missing_artifacts. ASSERTION_FAILED is valid only for an observed correctness-predicate failure with complete safe evidence; contradictory summary fields finalize INCONCLUSIVE/EVIDENCE_INVALID.
collection_responsibility.finalizer_bounds: 10 s timeout + 5 s kill grace; RLIMIT_AS 128 MiB, CPU 10 s, FSIZE 4 MiB, NOFILE 32, CORE 0.
collection_responsibility.finalizer_failure: No valid finalized record means INCONCLUSIVE and cannot PASS.
collection_responsibility.finalizer_semantic_authority: The same allowlisted finalizer uses common lease/supervisor/result-directory gates. Normal mode performs strict completeness/schema/replay checks and exact cleanup. Abnormal mode strictly validates pending record and supervisor receipt only, raw-preserves bounded evidence, records actual cleanup history, and never performs IPC, cleanup, journal mutation or retry.
collection_responsibility.harness_run: Only after dedicated UID launcher/lease verified: create pending record/journal, create/reserve candidates and collect evidence. After all worker joins and Process/GW destruction, append/fsync one RUN_SHUTDOWN_COMPLETE before any cleanup intent. The supervisor later emits supervisor-termination.json after process wait/log closure.
collection_responsibility.missing_or_invalid_staging: Metadata-only INCONCLUSIVE; assertions NOT_RUN, measurements null, inventories unavailable, exact cleanup status unknown, missing artifact names; no invented values.
collection_responsibility.outer_finalizer: The finalizer requires valid lease, result-directory identity, supervisor receipt, complete process reaping and closed logs for either mode. If common authority fails, leave pending and report BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE. Normal mode may clean only after durable shutdown proof; abnormal mode records INCONCLUSIVE without live IPC or new cleanup.
collection_responsibility.reservation_journal_artifact: reservation-journal.jsonl is required, final, max 256 KiB/128 events, append-only strict JSONL; each record is fsynced and its artifact hash is bound in run-record.
collection_responsibility.runtime_manifest_file: none; q0_q1_d2.manifest.json is plan/schema input, not part of runtime bundle.
collection_responsibility.shell_redirection: The outer supervisor captures stdout/stderr under D2_RESULTS and closes descriptors before finalization.
collection_responsibility.supervisor_termination_receipt: Trusted launcher writes/fsyncs supervisor-termination.json after waiting/reaping every recorded process PID and closing stdout/stderr. The finalizer binds the receipt PID set to execution_identity.process_tree_pids, decodes raw waitpid statuses, checks closed-log hashes and validates launcher/lease identity.
